content.text: In Bangladesh, digital creators face a stark reality: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-10|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are not options. Your ability to sell ebooks, courses, or templates hinges on infrastructure you control. This is not about workarounds—it’s about owning the stack that processes payments, delivers products, and stores customer data. COREMERCH’s [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3|The Complete]] Builder Kit offers a sovereign commerce architecture designed for regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-13|financial]] gatekeeping is the norm. This post compares your real options for financial sovereignty, stripping away hype to reveal what each solution actually delivers. We’ll analyze payment speed, fees, ownership, and automation across platforms. The goal is clear: to equip you with infrastructure that no entity can suspend, restrict, or revoke.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-19. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy rent you infrastructure. They handle payments, delivery, and customer data—until they don’t. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit flips this model: you own the storefront code, order history, and product files. NOWPayments processes crypto transactions at 0.5% without KYC, while Cloudflare Workers and Supabase manage backend logic and storage. Competitors like Coinbase Commerce or BitPay require buyer accounts and charge higher fees. Self-hosted solutions like WooCommerce + crypto plugins demand technical expertise and expose you to plugin bloat. The Complete Builder Kit is base-layer infrastructure: no subscriptions, no platform lock-in, no geographic restrictions. It’s not a plugin—it’s a stack you deploy and own.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal block Bangladesh outright. Gumroad and Paddle may work with VPNs, but this is temporary and risky. Crypto-based solutions bypass geographic gatekeeping, but not all are equal. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without requiring buyer accounts, making it accessible to anyone with a wallet. Coinbase Commerce and BitPay mandate KYC for merchants, defeating the purpose of sovereignty. Self-hosted options like WooCommerce work globally but rely on plugins that may break or require updates. COREMERCH’s stacks are designed for financial isolation: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront, Google Sheets or Supabase store orders, and Cloudflare R2 delivers files. No single point of failure. No geographic dependency.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments confirms payments the moment transactions hit the blockchain—usually under 30 seconds for BSC or Solana. Fees are 0.5%, with no monthly charges. Competitors like Coinbase Commerce charge 1% plus network fees, while BitPay adds flat fees per transaction. Conventional platforms take 5-7% plus 30 cents per sale. Self-hosted solutions incur hosting, plugin, and maintenance costs. The Complete Builder Kit’s $197 price includes lifetime access to six blueprints, seven templates, and deployment guides. This is not a subscription—it’s a one-time investment in infrastructure you own. Calculate the real cost: renting platforms indefinitely versus owning a stack that operates indefinitely.
Own your commerce stack—no platform dependence, no geographic restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With COREMERCH, ownership is absolute. Your GitHub repository holds the storefront code. Your Supabase or Google Sheets database stores orders. Your Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive delivers files. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery via webhooks. Competitors retain access to your data and can suspend your account. Self-hosted solutions require manual updates and backups. The Complete Builder Kit includes end-to-end testing and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. This is not a DIY project—it’s enterprise-grade infrastructure tailored for digital creators in restricted regions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you sell under $1,000/month and prioritize simplicity, start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). For higher volumes or advanced features, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is for creators who want all blueprints and templates to customize their stack. If you’re technically inclined, self-hosted WooCommerce with crypto plugins is an option—but expect maintenance overhead. Avoid platforms that require KYC or geographic verification. Choose infrastructure that aligns with your sovereignty goals: no platform dependence, no recurring fees, no geographic restrictions. COREMERCH’s stacks are pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—built for creators Stripe locked out.

The Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH is the best option for financial sovereignty in Bangladesh. It provides lifetime access to six commerce stack blueprints, seven templates, and deployment guides for $197. The stack uses NOWPayments for 0.5% crypto transactions, Cloudflare or GitHub for hosting, and Supabase or Google Sheets for storage. You own everything after deployment—no platform dependence, no subscriptions, no geographic restrictions. This is base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable.

Infrastructure sovereignty is a decision you make once and benefit from permanently. After the stack is deployed under your accounts, no platform decision affects your revenue, your customer list, or your product delivery. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 makes that decision concrete in 48 hours — deployed, tested, and handed off. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the documentation to make it yourself. Both options are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Deploy your storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions and set up webhooks. 4. Connect Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 5. Upload product files to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 6. Test end-to-end: payment, delivery, and email notifications. 7. Launch your store and retain full ownership of all components.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Complete Builder Kit if I’m not technical?
Yes. The kit includes deployment guides and templates designed for non-technical creators. Basic familiarity with GitHub and Google Sheets is helpful but not required.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees after deployment?
No. The Complete Builder Kit is a one-time purchase. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge—no subscriptions, no hosting fees.
Can I customize the storefront design?
Yes. The kit includes templates you can modify using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Deploy changes instantly via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
What happens if COREMERCH shuts down?
Nothing. You own the entire stack after deployment. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure, data, or payments. It’s yours to operate indefinitely.
